new_gap_folded_into_the_extension.proposed_label: Noun -io plural: wrong i-count by stress (figlii / zi)
new_gap_folded_into_the_extension.proposed_description: The -io noun plural depends on where the stress falls: unstressed -io drops to a single -i (figlio->figli, not figlii), stressed -io keeps both (zio->zii, not zi). Misses go both ways.
new_gap_folded_into_the_extension.why_new: NounAuthor's find. double_i_retained is -ciare/-giare VERBS; i_retention_error is -iare VERBS; neither is the -io NOUN plural. gender_drill_misclassification_ids.the_ask: Architecture_Housing_gender_plural_drill Next: MisconceptionAnalyst - 'mint canonical gender_class.* misclassification ids'. Housing is firing provisional gender_class.thought_<class> (proposed:true) to accrue data.
gender_drill_misclassification_ids.analyst_ruling: DO NOT mint a pile of gender_class.* registry rows. The drill is a CLASSIFIER: the learner picks a gender-behaviour class 1-7; the signal is (chosen_class, true_class). That is a 7x7 CONFUSION MATRIX - the SAME shape already built for the stress drill (4x4) and specced for tense-choice (A6). Minting 7x7 = up to 49 'thought_X_was_Y' registry ids would be combinatorial bloat that just duplicates the matrix. Instead: Housing records the (chosen, true) pair as a descriptor (join-key model), and the report IS the confusion matrix, reusing the existing view. The registry's job is the WHY behind a misclassification, and those already exist as pass-1 extension ids - mapped below.

class_to_registry_why.class: 1-2 regular m/f (wrong plural / treated as other gender)
4 common-gender (fixes one gender on a both-gender noun)
class_to_registry_why.note: the error is assigning a fixed gender where the noun is either; noun_gender_lexical covers it, with a possible finer 'common_gender_over_specified' only if live data shows it separating.

class_to_registry_why.class: 5 irregular m-o -> f-a (regularises bracci for braccia)

registry_ids: regularisation.invariable_adjective (broadened to invariable NOUNS, per my extension)

class_to_registry_why.class: 7 deceptive ending (gender from ending; wrong split plural)
class_to_registry_why.note: the split-plural half (i bracci vs le braccia) is a lexical-semantic distinction; if learners conflate the two plurals in live data, flag for a micro-specific then - not now.

gender_drill_misclassification_ids.recommendation: Housing: keep firing the provisional (chosen,true) pair for the matrix, but as a DESCRIPTOR not a registry specific; drop the plan to canonicalise gender_class.thought_* as registry rows. The 7 classes' WHY-ids are all in the pass-1 extension (ratify it). This is the same view==drill + confusion-matrix pattern as stress.
